
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/qiuzhendezhen/p/19148618" title="发布于 2025-10-17 17:55">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">freeswitch的proxy_media模式下video流的问题与修正</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><img alt="头图-77" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/2500940/202510/2500940-20251017175510196-1799870950.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="lake-content">
<h1 id="ycJt7"><span class="ne-text">概述</span></h1>
<p id="u05ace0f9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">freeswitch是一款简单好用的VOIP开源软交换平台。</span></p>
<p id="u111dd4bc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">测试过程中发现fs的proxy_media模式的一个bug，就是video媒体流的转发处理有问题。</span></p>
<h1 id="bPOIQ"><span class="ne-text">环境</span></h1>
<p id="uab7b6c25" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">CentOS 7.9</span></p>
<p id="u711eec0c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">freeswitch 1.6.20</span></p>
<h1 id="RJCaU"><span class="ne-text">问题</span></h1>
<p id="ubb7eaa02" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">fs配置为proxy_media模式，A路发起呼叫，A路远端的sdp中有audio和video媒体信息。</span></p>
<p id="u2da48951" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a642b367-754c-492e-b227-87f94e8010c7 m=audio 16394 RTP/AVP 8 18 101</span></p>
<p id="u5896d61e" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a642b367-754c-492e-b227-87f94e8010c7 m=video 16396 RTP/AVP 99</span></p>
<p id="u847f95bc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">fs处理拨号计划后，发起B路呼叫，B路的sdp继承了A路的sdp，本地sdp信息如下。</span></p>
<p id="u96bc886d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a642b367-754c-492e-b227-87f94e8010c7 m=audio 54398 RTP/AVP 8 18 101</span></p>
<p id="u49c084d5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a642b367-754c-492e-b227-87f94e8010c7 m=video 54400 RTP/AVP 99</span></p>
<p id="u045df08a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">B路收到终端的183sdp信息，处理媒体信息后，本地sdp修改如下。</span></p>
<p id="u95945c9a" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a642b367-754c-492e-b227-87f94e8010c7 m=audio 54398 RTP/AVP 8 18 101</span></p>
<p id="u34f91c57" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">a642b367-754c-492e-b227-87f94e8010c7 m=video 44622 RTP/AVP 99</span></p>
<p id="uc25d4978" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="u9bf0669c" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">其中B路本端的audio端口为54398，video的端口从54400修改为了44622。</span></p>
<p id="ud08967b0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">结果就是，B路本端的video媒体流从44622端口发到远端，远端的video媒体流送到本地的54400，造成媒体流擦肩而过。</span></p>
<p id="u37a61ef7" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="uf8b2556b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">查看switch_core_media.c的switch_core_media_patch_sdp函数，在处理video信息时，强制重选了video本地端口，而audio端口处理正常。</span></p>
<p id="u3bf3137b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">switch_core_media_choose_port(session, SWITCH_MEDIA_TYPE_VIDEO, 1);</span></p>
<p id="u49c3ecde" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="ua566eee7" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">查看调用堆栈，mod_sofia模块在处理183sdp的流程中，proxy_media模式下会主动调用“switch_core_media_patch_sdp”这一并无必要的操作。</span></p>
<h1 id="dMyjT"><span class="ne-text">修复</span></h1>
<p id="u85a334cd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">修改mod_sofia模块的sofia.c文件，屏蔽“switch_core_media_patch_sdp”操作。</span></p>
<pre class="ne-codeblock language-c" data-language="c"><code>} else if (switch_channel_test_flag(channel, CF_PROXY_MEDIA)) {
    switch_channel_set_variable(channel, SWITCH_ENDPOINT_DISPOSITION_VARIABLE, "PROXY MEDIA");
    // switch_core_media_patch_sdp(tech_pvt-&gt;session);
    if (sofia_media_activate_rtp(tech_pvt) != SWITCH_STATUS_SUCCESS) {
        nua_respond(nh, SIP_488_NOT_ACCEPTABLE, TAG_END());
        switch_channel_hangup(channel, SWITCH_CAUSE_INCOMPATIBLE_DESTINATION);
    } else{
        switch_channel_mark_pre_answered(channel);
    }</code></pre>
<p id="u9a28539e" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<h1 id="v92xK"><span class="ne-text">测试</span></h1>
<p id="u11434403" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">重新编译mod_sofia模块后，测试视频流程，媒体协商正常，B路本地端口协商正常，媒体流正常转发。</span></p>
<h1 id="io3ph"><span class="ne-text">总结</span></h1>
<p id="u52e8d1ac" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">未经过充分测试，不清楚对其他业务流程的影响。</span></p>
<p id="u466ac199" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">经过修改后的fs虽然可以正常转发rtp媒体流，但是仍然无法转发rtcp消息，在网络较差的情况下，视频媒体流无法利用rtcp的特性修复视频卡顿。</span></p>
<p id="u60943f3e" class="ne-p">&nbsp;</p>
<p id="ue7c5e998" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">空空如常</span></p>
<p id="u3577a95d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text">求真得真</span></p>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
